spinner.$description: 800ms for one full turn of a loading spinner. USE: rotating the loading icon in button and buttonIcon while state=Loading. DON'T: transitions or one-off state changes (this is for repeating loops only). PAIR: motion.easing.linear. RULE: under prefers-reduced-motion, stop the rotation but keep the icon visible and mark the control busy (aria-busy) so the status stays readable.

linear.$description: Constant-speed curve. USE: continuous loops such as the loading spinner, where speed must not change during a turn. DON'T: entrances, exits or position changes, which need acceleration or deceleration. PAIR: motion.duration.spinner.
